dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: As you can see, I have successfully directed Bloom Pruner: Radiant Wings to victory over the final foe of "Shuyu's Baffling Beetle Battle Bowl"...

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Could you now impart upon me some fundamentals of the mechanical arts...?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: You'll need a foundation in mathematics and engineering if you want to study the mechanical arts, so let me find you some textbooks and give you a couple more sets of test questions.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Actually, hang on a moment. How did the Beetle Battle get named after me, again?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I've heard about the previous iterations of the event. Weren't they all named after your big bro Itto?

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: That is how things used to be, yes, but considering the Oni King's personality, he'd likely say—

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: "Bloom Pruner's my nemesis, a foe I must defeat! Any tournament with my name on it has gotta have Crimson Staff take center stage!"

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Besides, it was thanks to you that this mystical beetle battle trial could be implemented at all, Master Shuyu, so of course your name should be on it!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Well, I wouldn't call myself much more than a middleman, passing your requests onto Master Xianyun and Madame Ping — they're the ones you should be thanking.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Of course, you don't have to send anything like that Semi-Automatic Tea Grinder... or whatever it was called, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: First, we wouldn't want you to break the bank for our sakes, and second, neither Master Xianyun nor Madame Ping really drinks much matcha in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Understood! Next time, I'll be sure to select a gift that better suits Master of Masters Xianyun and Adeptus Ping!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No wonder there were beetle-fighting challenges for us within that adeptal-realm-like Domain. It's all because of the expert beetle battler, Grandmaster Hanakado.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers that he played against Itto some time back, didn't he? Why'd he come all the way here to Mt. Aocang?

choices.text: He chose to stay in Liyue back then, didn't he?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: #Huh, that sounds like... Is that you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Oh, if it isn't the Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon! Well met, well met!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: In case you've forgotten my humble person, allow me to introduce myself...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: We have crossed paths before, during the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl and the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp.

choices.text: Oh, right, you're one of Itto's subordinates.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, yeah, Paimon remembers too! We beat you during the first big beetle battle, and you became one of Itto's advisors after that, helping him challenge a Geovishap Hatchling with his Onikabuto!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: That's right, and at the end of that great training arc, Guoba-san brought Adeptus Cloud Retainer's Bloom Pruner. That sure was a gap in ability if I've ever seen one...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: To rise to greater beetle-battling heights, the Oni King and I agreed to stay in Liyue and prepare suitable gifts to show our sincerity as we seek to learn from the adepti.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, nice, Adeptus Shuyu!

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: N—No, I'm not really an official teacher just yet. Grandmaster Hanakado just insists on calling me that.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Never mind being at the level of an adeptus... I'm not even close to making "half-adeptus"! It just so happens that Master taught me some of the basic principles of mechanics recently.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: She believes that people of similar ages communicate better with one another, and that teaching Grandmaster Hanakado will also help to reinforce my own learning.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: So for now, I'll be the one teaching him the basics, while at the same time, really getting a grasp on the specific mechanical fields he wants to learn about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Specific fields of study... Hmm, then that Serenitea Pot-like furnishing on the table, and the Onikabuto... trial against powerful opponents... They're all related!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: That's right! Adeptus Cloud Retainer and Adeptus Ping fashioned that masterpiece after hearing Master Shuyu's explanation. A truly amazing masterwork, believe you me!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: It's got all sorts of... monsters I'd never have dared get close to normally inside — though with the newly-equipped Bloom Pruner at full output, I could take them on head-to-head!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: And to show my respect, I'd like to name this "Shuyu's Baffling Beetle Battle Bowl"!

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: ...Uh, I still think you should name this after Xianyu— Master Cloud Retainer or Madame Ping instead...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, now that Paimon thinks about it, letting an Onikabuto go up against monsters certainly could give you results you can't get from ordinary beetle battles!

choices.text: Such battles might be somewhat outside an ordinary Onikabuto's purview...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, but Bloom Pruner isn't your run-of-the-mill Onikabuto! It'll be fine.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Actually, this is an annex of an adeptal realm that Master split off to improve Bloom Pruner's gardening functions.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: The monsters inside are all targets created using adeptal energy, and will act in set ways similar to those of the creatures they're based on. Their combat abilities aren't anywhere close to the originals, though...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Bloom Pruner would struggle to deal with opponents that many times its size, even at full power.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: W—Wait, so they're just simulated?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Well, the point here is to familiarize you with the operating logic behind devices like Bloom Pruner. In that sense, understanding its performance limits is also very important.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Perhaps my beetle battling skills are the limiting factor here. The Oni King said so too: "How can you talk about performance when you don't know the first thing about fighting"?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Good thing you're here, Oni King's Right Hand, Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: With your help, I'm sure I'll be able to see what Bloom Pruner can really do. I'm willing to pay for your services, of course...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: And for your part, you'll get to have more exciting battles!

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: #Hmm... I've never seen you in a beetle battle before, {NICKNAME}... Now I'm getting curious...

choices.text: Alright! Time to become the best beetle battlemaster!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: You've always been one!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—P—Paimon's really strong too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well then, there's no time to lose! {NICKNAME}, let's continue fighting our way through "Shuyu's Baffling Beetle Battle Bowl"!

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: I guess I'll just... have to accept this name, won't I?

choices.text: Let's do some fact-finding for Itto first...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: If the opportunity arises, I'll also write a letter to the Oni King to report on our current progress. I'll be sure to mention the generous aid you've offered!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, for all we know, he might just buy a boat ticket to bolt over here and try this new beetle battle before we can blink!

choices.text: The fights were pretty interesting, I've gotta say!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? Even Paimon wants to go for another round!

choices.text: That happened, did it? Mind continuing the introductions?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon sorta remembers... We beat you during the first big beetle battle, and you became one of Itto's advisors after that, helping him challenge a Geovishap Hatchling with his Onikabuto!

choices.text: I don't quite remember anymore. Who's Grandmaster Hanakado again?
